# bioexcel/biobb_dna/canal_unzip

## Summary

Tool for extracting biobb_canal output files.

Unzips a Canal output file contained within a zip file.

Nextflow adapter of the [CanalUnzip](https://biobb-dna.readthedocs.io/en/latest/curvesplus.html#module-curvesplus.canal_unzip) building block of [biobb_dna](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_dna) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_DNA_CANAL_UNZIP } from 'bioexcel/biobb_dna/canal_unzip'

workflow {
    BIOBB_DNA_CANAL_UNZIP(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_zip_file` | yes | zip | Zip file with Canal output files |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_path` | yes | ser, his, cor | Canal output file contained within input_zip_file |
| `output_list_path` | no, opt-in | txt | Text file with a list of all Canal output files contained within input_zip_file |
| `versions_biobb_dna` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_dna', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of CanalUnzip properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_list_path: 'txt']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_dna container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_DNA_CANAL_UNZIP' {
        ext.properties = [type: 'series']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | null | Type of file. Values: series, histo, corr. |
| `helpar_name` | string | null | Helical parameter name, only for 'series' and 'histo' types. Values: alphaC, alphaW, ampC, ampW, ax-bend, betaC, betaW, buckle, chiC, chiW, curv, deltaC, deltaW, epsilC, epsilW, gammaC, gammaW, h-ris, h-twi, inclin, majd, majw, mind, minw, opening, phaseC, phaseW, propel, reg, rise, roll, shear, shift, slide, stagger, stretch, tbend, tilt, tip, twist, xdisp, ydisp, zetaC, zetaW. |
| `correlation` | string | null | Correlation indexes separated by underscore (ie '98_165'), only for 'corr' type. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
